standard: CSS Grid Layout Module Level 1, 2025 CRD, sections 7.5, 7.6, 8.5, and 11.3-11.8
principles: grid-auto-rows and grid-auto-columns accept one or more track sizes.
For positive implicit tracks, the first size in the list applies after the last explicit track, and the list repeats in authored order.
Intrinsic contribution is evaluated for the generated track's axis and its placed items; the Chrome observation is a separate implementation oracle.
